detected_types.label: AMM / DEX (hybrid: ERC20 Token, Lending Pool, Staking / Rewards)

matched_invariants.title: Share inflation / first depositor attack prevention
matched_invariants.solidity: assert(totalSupply >= MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY || msg.sender == deployer); // Or use virtual shares: assert(totalSupply + VIRTUAL_OFFSET > 0);
matched_invariants.natural: Empty vaults must enforce minimum liquidity (burn initial shares to dead address) or use virtual shares/assets offset. The first depositor must not be able to manipulate the share exchange rate to steal from subsequent depositors. Share price must not be manipulable when totalSupply is near zero.

matched_invariants.title: Transfer should update accounting correctly
matched_invariants.natural: Valid transfers should update accounting correctly.

matched_invariants.title: TransferFrom should update accounting correctly
matched_invariants.natural: Valid transferFrom calls should update accounting correctly.

matched_invariants.title: Zero supply iff zero assets
matched_invariants.solidity: assert((vault.totalAssets() == 0) == (vault.totalSupply() == 0));
matched_invariants.natural: totalAssets must be zero if and only if totalSupply is zero. A vault with shares but no assets (or assets but no shares) indicates a critical accounting desync — the first depositor attack or a rounding drain.

matched_invariants.title: TransferFrom should decrease allowance correctly
matched_invariants.natural: After transferFrom, allowances should be updated correctly. Infinite allowance (type(uint256).max) may remain unchanged.

matched_invariants.title: Unchecked return value on ERC20 transfer
matched_invariants.solidity:
// Must use SafeERC20 or check return value
assert(IERC20(token).transfer(to, amount) == true);
matched_invariants.natural: All ERC20 transfer, transferFrom, and approve calls must check return values or use SafeERC20 wrappers. Tokens that return false on failure (instead of reverting) will silently fail, allowing state to advance without actual token movement. USDT notably does not return a value at all.

matched_invariants.title: Constant supply for non-mintable/non-burnable tokens
matched_invariants.solidity:
require(!isMintableOrBurnable);
assertEq(initialSupply, totalSupply(), "Token supply was modified");
matched_invariants.natural: Total supply should be constant for non-mintable and non-burnable tokens.

matched_invariants.title: User balance must not exceed total supply
matched_invariants.solidity: assertLte(balanceOf(msg.sender), totalSupply(), "User balance higher than total supply");
matched_invariants.natural: No user balance should be greater than the token's total supply.

matched_invariants.title: Sum of user balances must not exceed total supply
matched_invariants.solidity:
uint256 balance = balanceOf(USER1) + balanceOf(USER2) + balanceOf(USER3);
assertLte(balance, totalSupply(), "Sum of user balances higher than total supply");
matched_invariants.natural: The sum of users balances should not be greater than the token's total supply.

matched_invariants.title: Transfer of more than balance should revert
matched_invariants.natural: Transfers for more than account balance should not be allowed.

matched_invariants.title: TransferFrom of more than balance should revert
matched_invariants.natural: TransferFrom for more than account balance should not be allowed.

matched_invariants.title: Mint should update balance and total supply correctly
matched_invariants.natural: User balance and total supply should be updated correctly after minting.

matched_invariants.title: Token approval not cleared after use / dangerous approvals
matched_invariants.solidity: assert(token.allowance(address(this), spender) == 0 || spender.isImmutableTrusted()); // No residual approvals to arbitrary-execution contracts
matched_invariants.natural: Token approvals granted by a contract to external addresses must be carefully managed. Residual approvals left after operations can be exploited. Approvals to arbitrary-execution contracts are especially dangerous. The Coinbase hack exploited an accidental approval to a 0x swapper.

matched_invariants.title: Self transfer should not break accounting
matched_invariants.natural: Self transfers should not break accounting.

matched_invariants.title: Self transferFrom should not break accounting
matched_invariants.natural: Self transferFrom should not break accounting.

matched_invariants.title: Burn should update balance and total supply correctly
matched_invariants.natural: User balance and total supply should be updated correctly when burn is called.

matched_invariants.title: Initializer can only run once
matched_invariants.natural: The initialize function must revert on any call after the first successful execution. Re-initialization can reset owner, steal funds, or corrupt state. This generalizes BASE-058.

matched_invariants.title: Donation to inflate exchange rate
matched_invariants.solidity: assert(exchangeRate_after <= exchangeRate_before * (100 + MAX_RATE_CHANGE_PCT) / 100); // Per-block rate change limit
matched_invariants.natural: Direct token transfers (donations) to a vault or pool must not be usable to inflate the exchange rate beyond a safety threshold. If totalAssets() relies on balanceOf instead of internal accounting, an attacker can donate tokens to manipulate the share price.

matched_invariants.title: redeem(deposit(a)) <= a — no extraction profit
matched_invariants.solidity: uint256 shares = vault.deposit(assets, user); uint256 got = vault.redeem(shares, user, user); assert(got <= assets);
matched_invariants.natural: If a user deposits `a` assets and immediately redeems all received shares, they must get back at most `a` assets. Getting more means the vault leaks value to depositor-redeemers, enabling extraction via repeated roundtrips.

matched_invariants.title: Underlying balance >= internal cash accounting
matched_invariants.solidity: assert(IERC20(vault.asset()).balanceOf(address(vault)) >= vault.internalCash());
matched_invariants.natural: The actual ERC20 balance of the underlying asset held by the vault must always be greater than or equal to the vault's internal cash accounting variable. A deficit means the vault is insolvent or tokens were extracted without updating accounting.
